references.text: Rahab was also a prostitute, and her story shows how God can use people from various backgrounds for His purposes.
Gideon was also called a 'mighty warrior' by the angel of the Lord, the same description used for Jephthah.
Gilead is mentioned as a patriarch, and Jephthah was from the Gilead clan.
Gilead was the son of Machir and father to several clans, including Jephthah's family.
The context before Jephthah's story, where the people of Gilead sought a leader to fight against the Ammonites.
Jephthah is mentioned among the heroes of faith in Hebrews as an example of faith in action.
Tamar was mistaken for a prostitute, yet she became part of the lineage of the Messiah, demonstrating God's grace toward people with difficult backgrounds.
